confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of the Mexican Caribbean market, not live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately certain, since Tulum prices vary widely between town-center and beach-zone venues. Accommodation anchors are less certain, because July is peak domestic summer season and the Hotel Zone carries a large premium over the town. Taxes and mandatory fees are assumed to be included. Beer and wine/cocktail anchors are set by local price relationships: the wine and cocktail estimates sit above the beer estimate, which is the usual pattern in Tulum bars. The FX observation (15 Oct 2026) was taken from a search summary of the RBA site; I could not confirm the rate on the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Mexican Caribbean resort towns such as Playa del Carmen and Cancún, with an adjustment for Tulum's boutique and beach-zone price premium on drinks and lodging, and a lower-cost town-center tier for inexpensive meals and budget beds.
